answer.rationale: Use the low-cost quote as a benchmark to negotiate an incumbent renewal that meets the 18% mandate while preserving the existing integration and scheduled-delivery stability. At 94% committed line volume and with only 14 days to expiry, a primary-vendor switch creates unvalidated transition and delivery-capacity risk even though prior onboarding and invoicing performance were favorable. Verify the prior benchmarking result and the low-cost vendor record before committing; neither inherited record establishes current capacity, lead-time reliability, or changeover risk.
